title: [review] tx_queue.py:403: `pop()` does not update transm
description: The `pop()` method signals success to the reservation but does not increment `stats.packets_transmitted` or update the latency EMA, unlike `_remove_first()` and `complete(success=True)`. This causes transmission metrics to underreport actual transmissions if code paths use `pop()` instead of the other dequeue methods.
